headline: As a plus-one, I was just a FOREIGN KEY. My validity depended entirely on pointing to your primary key.
caption:
As a plus-one, I was just a FOREIGN KEY. My validity depended entirely on pointing to your primary key.

—
FOREIGN KEY: a column pointing at another table's primary key.
